description.value:
“Brock’s keeping that superheavy junk-bow. We tried telling him to pack real iron, but he just smiled and said, ‘go ahead, try to take it from me.’ And with all due respect boss, fuck that. I saw what he can do with that thing. Oh, by the way, Jamie’s dead.”

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Poor Quality Bow • Skill: Archery • Range: Bow

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: NoSlots: 3 • Attachments: Reinforced String • Mods: None

Special Features: If fired by a user with BODY 11+, whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, the user rolls twice on the Critical Injury table and chooses their favorite option for the victim to suffer. Requires BODY 8+ or a Cyberarm to wield.

Range: Bow
Pre-installed: Reinforced String (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
